Neugebauer, co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., has suspended his current proxy campaign to call a special meeting of shareholders due to a judge's last-minute recusal, which has disrupted the timeline for the strategic process. Despite having earned the backing of leading proxy advisory firms and a majority of votes cast, Neugebauer will continue to push for good governance through the judicial process.
